label: Ручка
description: A 10-sentence usage card for ручка (pen; handle).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Ручка' is nominative as the subject of 'лежит'. 'Синяя' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'на столе' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Ручку' is the accusative direct object of 'дай'. 'Мне' is the dative recipient, and 'пожалуйста' softens the request.
Strategic focus: Genitive of negation. 'Ручки' takes the genitive form after 'нет' to express absence. The possession frame 'у меня' names the owner.
Strategic focus: Instrumental tool. 'Ручкой' is in the instrumental case marking the writing instrument. 'Новой' agrees in the feminine instrumental, and 'письмо' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Ручку' takes the accusative after 'за' to show what you pull. Here 'ручка' means the handle, and 'дверь' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Ручке' uses the prepositional form after 'в' to show where the ink ran out. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after numeral. 'Ручки' takes the genitive singular form required after 'три'. 'Лежат' is plural to match the counted set.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Ручки' is nominative plural as the subject. 'Все' quantifies them, 'в коробке' gives location, and 'мои' is the plural possessive.
Strategic focus: Nominative with genitive possessor. 'Ручка' is nominative as the predicate noun. 'Моей сестры' is the genitive showing whose pen it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Ручку' is accusative after 'за', here the diminutive sense of a child's little hand. 'Ребёнка' is the animate accusative object.
